name: Sun Shield Shirt
description: High-performance sun shirt with UPF 50+ sun protection, blocking 98% of harmful UV rays. Slightly fitted, falls at hip. Moisture-wicking, abrasion-resistant fabric. Machine washable and dryable. Recommended by The Skin Cancer Foundation.

name: Men's Tropical Plaid Short-Sleeve Shirt
description: Our lightest hot-weather shirt rated UPF 50+ for superior protection from the sun's UV rays. SunSmart technology blocks 98% of harmful UV rays. Wrinkle-resistant, front and back cape venting for cool breezes. Two front bellows pockets.

name: Women's Sun-Blocking Fishing Vest
description: Multi-pocket fishing vest with built-in UPF 50+ sun protection. Lightweight mesh back panel for ventilation. Ten pockets to store gear, plus a rod holder loop. Machine washable.

name: Men's Classic Denim
column3: Comfortable five-pocket denim jeans in a classic straight fit. 100% cotton, stonewashed for a broken-in feel. Machine washable, imported.

name: Women's Campside Oxfords
description: Lightweight canvas oxfords perfect for casual walks or light hiking. Rubber traction outsole and cushioned footbed. Available in three colors.

name: Recycled Waterhog Dog Mat
description: Durable, chew-proof dog mat made from 94% recycled materials. Absorbs water and dirt, keeping floors clean. Machine washable, non-slip backing.

name: Infant and Toddler Girls' Coastal Chill Swimsuit
description: Two-piece swimsuit with UPF 50+ sun protection built into the fabric. Ruffle trim, easy on-off snaps. Chlorine-resistant, quick drying.

name: Refresh Swimwear V-Neck Tankini
description: Chlorine-resistant tankini top with UPF 50+ built-in sun protection. Racerback straps for a secure fit. Pairs with our swim bottoms.

name: EcoFlex 3L Storm Pants
description: Waterproof, breathable rain pants built for storm-level conditions. Fully seam-sealed with reinforced knees. Adjustable waist and ankle cuffs.

name: Alpine Fleece Quarter-Zip Pullover
description: Midweight fleece pullover for cool mornings and evenings around camp. Brushed interior for extra warmth. Zippered chest pocket.

name: Women's NRS Endurance Wetsuit
description: 3mm neoprene wetsuit designed for cold-water paddling. Flexible panels at the shoulders for full range of motion. UPF 50+ fabric on exposed panels.

name: Trail Runner Hiking Shoes
description: Lightweight trail shoes with aggressive rubber outsole for grip on loose terrain. Breathable mesh upper, cushioned midsole. Not water resistant.

name: Men's Storm Shell Rain Jacket
description: Fully waterproof shell jacket with taped seams and adjustable hood. Packs into its own chest pocket. Not designed for sun protection, focused on rain performance.

name: Kids' Beach Comber Sandals
description: Quick-dry sandals with adjustable straps for a secure fit at the beach or pool. Rubber outsole grips wet rocks. Machine washable straps.

name: Women's Sun Shade Hoodie
description: Featherweight hoodie with UPF 50+ sun protection and thumbholes to cover the backs of your hands. Ideal for paddling, hiking, or a day at the beach.
